comparator.name: French Language and Culture
comparator.route: French specialisation; 2026-entry ordinary programme, supported components only
comparator.sourceNotes: Exact French specialisation within Romance Languages and Cultures, CROHO56074, BA180EC. Adopted annual programme/general OER controls the 2026-entry review. Article5pp7–9 visibly repeats three identical 5-EC codes across B1/B2; count each once. Article6 has no replacement rule; Article7 old-unit transitions/individual advisor substitutions do not define the new entrant missing15EC. Archived2025–26B1 is different but cannot be silently substituted into the2026new-entry route. Future-labelled prospectus years cannot override the annual OER. B3 now has 30ECfree space+5ECprofessionalworld+5ECinternship+10ECpairedrestrictedchoice+10ECthesis, not a separately required15ECabroad-major block. French programme-specific prerequisites are marked not applicable; Spanish prerequisites do not apply. Mentoring/RADAr/PPO are0EC, attendance and Paris study visit apply separately.

components.name: Research Seminar
components.note: Restricted paired choice: LET-RTCBF216-A must be taken with LET-RTCBF218. Alternatively choose the paired 5-EC EU Law and 5-EC French–Dutch Legal Translation courses together. First-listed pair instantiated independently of UCR fit.

components.name: Translation in an Administrative Context
components.note: LET-RTCBF218; inseparable partner of the selected Research Seminar. The alternative legal pair is not an extra required 10 EC.

components.name: Bachelor Thesis: French Cultural Studies
components.note: 10 EC; first-listed LET-RTCBF304C selected independently of UCR fit. Alternatives are French Literature or French Linguistics thesis, each 10 EC.

Select French, not Spanish or generic Romance studies. First-listed B3 restricted course pair and thesis field are used solely to display supported allocation; no UCR fit-based route choice.

programmes.label: French Language and Culture at Radboud University

exception.reason: The adopted 2026–2027 French programme table repeats LET-RTCBF222, LET-RTCBF209 and LET-RTCBF120, each 5 EC, in both B1 and B2. No current new-entrant rule authorising repeat credit or naming three distinct replacement units is established. The nominal 180-EC table therefore supports only 165 distinct EC; the remaining 15 EC require authoritative cohort-specific clarification.
exception.curriculumContext: Degree size remains180EC. The supported distinct subset is B1 60EC+B2 45EC+B3 60EC=165EC. It is a diagnostic subset, not a complete degree route. Noncredit mentoring/RADAr/PPO, attendance and Paris study visit remain requirements. No final UCR comparison or no-match is approved while the external curriculum remains unresolved.

audience.programmeDescription: Study French language, literature and culture, including linguistics, French-speaking societies and the history of France. The degree develops advanced spoken and written French and academic research skills.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The published requirements do not yet establish a complete curriculum for a reliable programme comparison. The supported components are shown below; UCR alternatives are withheld.

curriculum.limitation: The degree is 180 EC. This list accounts for 165 distinct EC because three courses appear in both the first- and second-year requirements. Clarification is needed about the remaining 15 EC. This is a partial list, not a complete degree pathway.
